about_the_game:
Battle System

  • Match cards by pairing face-up cards in your hand with cards on the field, similar to the memory game concentration

  • Matching cards = playing cards (equivalent to the card-playing action in typical card games)

  • Your turn ends after 3 failed matching attempts

  • With good luck and memory, you can take multiple actions per turn

  • You take damage each time you fail to match cards

  • Some cards have effects just by being placed on the field, or activate effects without needing to be matched

  • Turn-based system where you and the enemy alternate actions

  • Reduce the enemy's HP to 0 before you are defeated

short_description: Memory meets deck-building in this addictive roguelike! Simple rules, instant fun - match memorized cards for satisfying battles. Perfect balance of memory and luck gives everyone a winning chance. No complex mechanics, just pure card battle enjoyment you can play anytime!
